context: A Czech post from the Facebook page of one of nine popular Czech brands, collected in 2013 and kept as text only. Two annotators labelled the sentiment towards the brand, product or service of the page, and a third and a fourth annotator settled their disagreements. Complaints are negative, joy or praise about the brand is positive, and a post whose opinion does not concern the page is neutral. Posts that were both positive and negative were removed.
